author: Chatrchyan, Serguei and others
title: Search for a Higgs Boson Decaying into a Z and a Photon in pp Collisions at sqrt(s) = 7 and 8 TeV
abstract: A search for a Higgs boson decaying into a Z boson and a photon is described using 5.0 fb-1 at 7 TeV and 19.6 fb-1 at 8 TeV. No excess is found. The observed limits at 95% CL are between about 4 and 25 times the SM cross section times branching fraction in the 120-160 GeV mass range. At 125 GeV, the observed limit is about 7.3 times the SM prediction.
